targets.query:
from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "process_variable")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "environment"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r.environment }))
  |> last(column: "_value")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "process_variable")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "algorithm"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: r.algorithm }))
  |> last(column: "_value")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rtt_ms")
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "process_variable" or r["_field"] == "setpoint")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "tracking")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "control_signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "u_t")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rtt_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "rtt")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "err")
